entries.proposition: Ethosuximide abolished spike-and-wave discharges in the first hour in all twelve digenic mice after systemic injection, with recurrence as the drug declined. The EEG drug experiment is in mutants only; no wild-type mouse is reported to have been dosed on the EEG endpoint.
entries.snippet: We found that SWDs were abolished in the first hour after treatment in all DiGstg+Ca1A mice (N = 12) upon systemic injection of ETX
entries.anchor: Results, Ethosuximide suppresses seizures but fails to rescue the social deficit

entries.proposition: Ethosuximide produced a broad-band reduction of cortical EEG power across frequencies, beyond SWD power, and the authors read this as an effect beyond the canonical thalamic T-type action. This is an observation of the drug's cortical-activity footprint, not a mechanistic dissection.
entries.snippet: EEG power spectrum analysis revealed broad-band cortical suppression following ETX administration, suggesting effects beyond its canonical action on thalamic T-type calcium channels (38).
entries.anchor: Discussion, Dissociation between seizures and neurocognitive behavior deficits

entries.proposition: The authors report that ethosuximide treatment did not rescue the social deficits in the digenic mice.
entries.snippet: we found that ETX treatment did not rescue the social deficits in DiGstg+Ca1A mice (Fig. 2E).
entries.anchor: Results, Ethosuximide suppresses seizures but fails to rescue the social deficit

entries.proposition: Figure 1 read as an image: in the digenic mice 15 of 15 recorded show epilepsy against 1 of 17 of the heterozygous Cacna1a line and none of 20 wild type and 12 Cacng2 mice; the spike-wave frequency about 20 per hour in the digenic line; in the three-chamber test sociability is intact in both groups but social novelty is lost in the digenic mice (preference index about 0, P = 0.47) with controls clearly positive (about 0.3).

entries.anchor: Figure 1 panels E, F, M (page 3 render)

entries.proposition: Figure 2 read as an image: ethosuximide takes the total spike-wave duration per 30 minutes from about 100 s before to near zero in the next 90 minutes (three stars; 12 mice) with recovery of a few discharges at 3 hours; broad suppression of EEG power across all frequencies; distance travelled unchanged (about 22 against 25 m); social-novelty preference index of the digenic mice remains lower than control after ethosuximide (star), sociability unchanged.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2: ETX SWD duration per 30 min about 100 s -> near 0 (***, N = 12) with partial return by 3 h; power broadly lower; distance unchanged; social novelty remains lower than Ctrl (*) after ETX.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 panels B-F (page 4 render)

entries.proposition: Figure 3 read as an image: Cacna1g-null cells lose the rebound spikes (about 5 in the digenic against 0 in the triple mutant, three stars) and the T-type current (peak about 1.4 nA at minus 45 mV against about 0); no spontaneous spike-wave discharge in the Cacna1g knockout (9 mice) or the triple mutant (7 mice); social-novelty preference remains lost in the triple mutant (star against control, P = 0.042) and sociability is intact.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3C-J: rebound spikes about 5 vs 0 (***); T-current about 1.4 nA vs about 0 (***); no SWD in Ca1G KO (N = 9) or triple (N = 7); triple mutant social novelty lost (*, P = 0.042).
entries.anchor: Figure 3 panels C-J (page 5 render)

entries.proposition: Figure 4 read as an image: PV-specific Cacna1a deletion alone: 4 of 12 mice with epilepsy; with Cacng2 haploinsufficiency 11 of 12; spike-wave frequency about 30 per hour in the combined line against near 0 in the single-deletion line; both show social-novelty deficits; open-field distance about 28 in controls against about 24 in the single-deletion line (two stars) and unchanged in the combined line.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4C-I: epilepsy 4/12 PV-Ca1A vs 11/12 DiGstg+PV-Ca1A; SWD about 30/h in the combined line; social novelty reduced in both; open-field distance lower in PV-Ca1A (**), not in combined.
entries.anchor: Figure 4 panels C-I (page 6 render)

entries.proposition: Figure 5 read as an image: designer-receptor activation of parvalbumin cells raises the membrane potential from about minus 68 to about minus 52 mV (three stars) and lowers rheobase; in the chemogenetic mice the low-dose clozapine takes the total spike-wave duration per 30 minutes from about 200 s to about zero from the third half hour on (stars, seven mice) and lifts oscillatory gamma power (P = 0.052); social-novelty preference, impaired before, is not different from control after (P = 0.56).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5C-O: Vm about -68 -> -52 mV (***); SWD duration per 30 min about 200 s -> near 0 from section 3 (*), N = 7; gamma power P = 0.052; social novelty P = 0.56 after Cloz vs 1.9e-4 before.
